title: Gears of War
japaneseTitle: ギアーズ・オブ・ウォー
shortDescription: Epic Games' genre-defining third-person shooter that established the over-the-shoulder cover mechanic and catapulted Unreal Engine 3 to dominance.
historicalSignificance: The definitive killer app of the early Xbox 360 era, selling over 5 million copies, popularizing the 'stop-and-pop' active cover system, and cementing Unreal Engine 3 as the industry's universal multiplatform development standard.

editorialContent.overview: Set on the devastated planet Sera fourteen years after 'Emergence Day' when the subterranean Locust Horde wiped out a quarter of humanity, former soldier Marcus Fenix is freed from prison to lead Delta Squad on a desperate mission to deploy the Lightmass Bomb.
editorialContent.gameplay: Revolutionized third-person action with the roadie run sprint, contextual button-activated cover sliding, chainsaw bayonet duels, and the ingenious 'Active Reload' timing mechanic that rewarded precise button presses with damage boosts.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: The flagship showcase for Unreal Engine 3 on the Xbox 360, displaying groundbreaking normal mapping, specular highlights, and wet concrete shaders that defined seventh-generation visual aesthetics.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Became an instant multiplayer phenomenon on Xbox Live, dethroning Halo 2 as the most-played online game and spawning a multi-billion dollar franchise.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on Xbox 360 dual-layer DVD, playable at 60 FPS with 4K enhancements on Xbox Series X via backward compatibility.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 5 million copies sold on Xbox 360
awards: Overall Game of the Year 2006 (Interactive Achievement Awards)

technicalSpecs.resolution: 720p HD at 30fps (Xbox 360) / 4K 60fps (Ultimate Edition on Xbox One)
